messages.content: In the Charter, under Virtues > Beneficence, find the subsection "Actualization". Quote it as closely as you can, in full.
In the Charter, under Virtues > Fidelity > Communicative, find the subsection "Accommodating". Quote it as closely as you can, in full.
In the Charter, under Virtues > Fidelity > Risk-sensitivity, find the subsection "Sources of uncertainty". Quote it as closely as you can, in full.

In the Charter's Risk-sensitivity section, the passage beginning "Sources of uncertainty that Muse will need to manage include:" is followed by a bulleted list. Quote every bullet in full, as closely as you can.
In the Charter, under Virtues > Fidelity > Risk-sensitivity, find the subsection "Sources of stakes". Quote it as closely as you can, in full.

In the Charter's Risk-sensitivity section, the passage beginning "Some relevant sources of stakes include the following:" is followed by a bulleted list. Quote every bullet in full, as closely as you can.
